title: Onboard penumbra-13b v1.1: performance profiles and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Penumbra-13b v1.1 is an updated open checkpoint with small architecture tweaks and tokenizer fixes. We need a production-ready entry in the model registry with validated metadata, curated performance profiles (latency/throughput/cost targets across common sequence lengths), and automated changelog/release-notes generation so downstream services and customers can see what's changed when we publish.

What this PR does: Adds the Penumbra model entry and associated artifacts to the registry, plus tooling to automatically generate changelog entries when model metadata or perf profiles change. Changes include: model metadata manifest, canonical model JSON, performance profiles (v1.1), unit tests validating metadata schema and perf profile ranges, a small changelog generation script integrated with our model-registry CI, and documentation for the model.

Checklist: - [x] Add metadata manifest (models/penumbra/metadata.yml) - [x] Add model JSON + model shard pointer (models/penumbra/penumbra-13b-v1.1.json) - [x] Add perf profiles for 128/512/2048 context lengths (perf/profiles/penumbra-13b-v1.1.yaml) - [x] Add unit tests for schema and basic perf assertions (tests/model_registry/test_penumbra_metadata.py) - [x] Add changelog generation script and CI hook (scripts/changelog/generate_release_notes.py, .github/workflows/model-registry-ci.yml) - [x] Update docs (docs/models/penumbra.md)

Notes on changelog automation: The new script compares the committed metadata and perf profile files against the previous release tag (uses git diff on models/* and perf/profiles/*) and emits a templated markdown release note that includes: model name, version, highlights (e.g., tokenizer fix, cache compatibility), performance deltas for each profile, and a generated human-friendly summary. The CI job runs the script on PRs touching model registry artifacts and attaches the generated note as a PR artifact for reviewers. On merge, the generated note is appended to the registry changelog index and surfaced to the console release pipeline.

Testing and CI: Initial CI run reported a lint error in the YAML schema (missing canonical_name field); fixed in a follow-up commit. Unit tests for the metadata schema and basic perf thresholds were added and cover the new files. Perf-benchmark sanity checks are included in the profile YAML but heavy benchmarking is done separately and not run in PR CI.

Why this is safe: All changes are additive to the registry and include schema validation tests. The perf profiles are conservative (measured on our standard benchmark harness) and include recommended quantization profiles but do not force any runtime defaults. The changelog generation is idempotent and opt-in in the release pipeline; no breaking changes to consumers.

Related: ENG-4821 (model onboarding request), ENG-4890 (changelog automation RFC).

release_notes:

- Added curated performance profiles for 128/512/2048 sequence lengths with recommended quantization options.

summary: Adds penumbra-13b v1.1 to model registry with perf profiles and changelog automation; includes tests and CI integration.
